notes: Gen 3 whole-turn parity scripts for src/BattleSim3 (Lua) and its Node twin. Every species, move, item name and number here is synthetic; effect/num/ability/hold-effect ids are the pret enum values the sheet contract (docs/plans/gen3-battle-sheet.md) names. create.typeTable '$chart' and create.movePool '$pool' stand for the shared typeTable / movePool below. Replay: create -> steps (see tests/battle_sim3_turn.lua header) -> compare expect.
